title: cordia tomentosa
intro: Cordia tomentosa, commonly known as East Indian ivy or Rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the Bignoniaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, and the Caribbean. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, relieve pain, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Cordia tomentosa include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which may contribute to its use in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, such as cordia-3, a compound that has been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
